[P2] Track already-cancelled adapter tasks as interruptions

If an adapter phase awaits a cancelled future or raises `CancelledError`, `_bounded` reports an operation error, but the task is already done and never enters `residual`. With valid independent retirement evidence, the coordinator can consequently release the case lease and call `finish(quiescent=True)`, bypassing its run-wide interruption policy. Cancellation can leave external work running after the Python task finishes. Record already-cancelled tasks as interruptions too, and extend the adapter-cancellation test to check quarantine and final quiescence flags.
